sloka: हन्त्येव नियमाद्वध्यानवध्ये च न कुप्यति ।युनक्त्यर्थैः प्रहृष्टश्च तमसौ यत्र तुष्यति ॥२-२-४६॥
transliteration: hantyeva niyamādvadhyānavadhye ca na kupyati ।yunaktyarthaiḥ prahṛṣṭaśca tamasau yatra tuṣyati ॥2-2-46॥

translations.english: When pleased, Rama bestows wealth. Like the Sun shining with his rays, He shines with his qualities of tranquil, charming and loving nature.
